Subject: POC launch: workbench orientation, prompt review, and load plan

Elaine —

Great to connect last week. Want to get the POC workbench orientation and the hands-on sessions on the calendar so we can align on roles, run prompt review together, and schedule load trials. Proposed agenda (90 minutes):

- 0–15m: Introductions & success criteria (stakeholder roles: engineering, data science, product)
- 15–40m: Prompt walkthrough + routing expectations (examples you want to test)
- 40–70m: Live routing test & short inference demo (observability hooks)
- 70–90m: Load trial plan, metrics, next steps

Proposed time slots (US PDT):
- Wed Aug 11, 10:00–11:30
- Thu Aug 12, 14:00–15:30
- Mon Aug 16, 09:00–10:30

Attaching a short roster template and our initial load-test plan so you can add internal participants and constraints. If those slots don’t work, tell me a couple alternatives and we’ll re-run availability.

Quick ask: please reply with the primary attendees (name + role), the prompts or prompt sets you want covered, and any SLOs/latency targets you care about for the load run.

Thanks — excited to get this rolling.

--
Markus Klein
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.inference.com
Redwood Inference

Attachments: POC_Roster.csv, LoadTestPlan_v1.pdf, Prompt_Review_Guide.docx

Markus —

Thanks for the clear agenda and materials. All useful. We’d like to include Raj Patel (Platform Lead) on the session — looping him in here. Our prefered slot is Thu Aug 12 but earlier in the day would be better for our EU stakeholders; would you be open to 11:00–12:30 PDT instead of 14:00?

Attendee list from our side (tentative):
- Elaine Park (Product Lead)
- Raj Patel (Platform Lead)
- Marina Lopez (ML Engineer, may join later for load test)

Prompts: we’ll share a 6-prompt seed set before the meeting (intent classification + entity recovery + short generation). SLOs: 95th percentile latency target < 250ms for single-goal inference; cost sensitivity: keep avg token cost < target TBD.

Also: curious if Redwood can expose KV prefix caching stats during the demo — that will help our performance assessment.

Best,
Elaine

Hi all —

11:00–12:30 PDT on Thu Aug 12 works for our engineering team; I’ll block Markus’ calendar and send an invite with the agenda below. I’ll also add a short pre-read in Drive with example traces and the minimal test harness we plan to use.

Role/owner suggestions for the session:
- FinCove: Elaine (product, success criteria), Raj (platform, infra constraints), Marina (ML bench + test config)
- Redwood: Markus (demo + routing), Hannah (load plan + ingestion), Dylan (observability + KV cache instrumentation)

Suggested success criteria (we can refine):
- Prompt fidelity: seed prompts produce expected top-3 intents at >85% on sample set
- Latency: 95th percentile < 250ms for standard route; P95 for fallback route < 400ms
- Scaling: backend can sustain 200 concurrent inference sessions at target latency for a 10m burst

Logistics:
- Please drop your sample prompts in the shared Drive folder before Tue Aug 10 so we can bake them into the harness.
- If you have firewall/VPN restrictions, let us know; internal infra access may be required for KV cache telemetry.

Thanks — I’ll attach the pre-read and a brief runbook to the invite.

—Hannah
